contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents starting consequential Agentic Engineering work
contract.outcome: A selected repository rejects a structurally incomplete new plan before coordination mutation and later outcome selection remains bound to the qualified plan at the immutable baseline revision.

canonical_journey.starting_state: PI-02B is accepted, the exact v3 maintenance allocation remains active on the closed provider claim, and a normal PI-02C reservation can attach only as selection-pending.
canonical_journey.input: The exact active v3 allocation, one revision-bound PI-02C claim and tracker, the accepted Plan 125 graph, and a v5 contract limited to the runtime plan-binding source and test paths.
canonical_journey.action: Prove the pending claim cannot write source, park v3, allocate and select v5 on that exact claim, then implement selection-time Planning Integrity validation at the immutable baseline revision.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Claim, tracker, worktree, plan graph, allocation, and selection agree on one revision-bound PI-02C lane; an in-scope source prewrite is admitted only after selection; incomplete or mismatched baseline plans cannot create a selection binding.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: A pending claim writes source; v3 remains active while v5 allocates; the allocation or selection binds a different claim; a missing or invalid baseline plan still creates a binding; an out-of-scope path is admitted; or generated evidence is treated as normative authority.
